title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Dartmouth College
description: Late-night dining at Dartmouth is a mix of campus-run staples and local Hanover favorites that keep students fueled through long study sessions and social nights.

cards.title: FoCo Late Night
cards.subtitle: The Central Dining Hub
cards.notes: Reopens from 9:30 PM to 1:30 AM for à la carte fried favorites like chicken tenders and mozzarella sticks. It is the primary social gathering spot after dark.
cards.short_summary: The main dining hall's late-night session offering comfort food and a lively social atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The Class of 1953 Commons reopens for late-night dining from 9:30 p.m. to 1:30 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 9:30 PM - 1:30 AM during the academic year.

cards.title: The Library Lifeline
cards.subtitle: Baker-Berry Library
cards.notes: Located in the library, this spot is essential for late-night study sessions, offering coffee, snacks, and pre-packaged meals until 2:00 AM.
cards.short_summary: A high-traffic cafe inside the main library providing caffeine and snacks for late-night studiers.
cards.evidence_claim: Novack Cafe serves as a late-night alternative for students working in the library, often open until 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: They Are What They Eat | Dartmouth Alumni Magazine
cards.access_notes: Typically open until 2:00 AM on weeknights during terms.

cards.title: Late Night Collis
cards.subtitle: Collis Student Center
cards.notes: Known for made-to-order pasta and stir-fry, this student center staple reopens at 9:30 PM for a more customized late-night meal.
cards.short_summary: A student center cafe offering customizable hot meals like pasta and smoothies during late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Collis Cafe reopens at 9:30 p.m. for Late Night, offering pasta, chicken tenders, and paninis.
cards.access_notes: Late-night hours typically start at 9:30 PM.

cards.title: The 24/7 Engineering Hub
cards.subtitle: Engineering & Computer Science Center
cards.notes: An automated snack bar open 24/7, providing coffee, tea, and a variety of snacks for students in the West End of campus.
cards.short_summary: A fully automated, 24/7 snack bar located in the Thayer School of Engineering building.
cards.evidence_claim: Back of the Napkin is a 24/7 snack bar in the Engineering and Computer Science building.
cards.source_title: Late Night Food Options! - Dartmouth Admissions
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: Molly's Weekend Run
cards.subtitle: South Main Street
cards.notes: A local favorite for wood-fired pizzas and truffle fries, staying open until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays for late-night diners.
cards.short_summary: A popular Hanover restaurant known for its bread and honey butter, offering late hours on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Molly's Restaurant is open until midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM on Friday and Saturday; 10:00 PM other nights.

cards.title: The Lou's Challenge
cards.subtitle: South Main Street
cards.notes: A legendary tradition where students pull an all-nighter and wait for Lou's to open at 6:00 AM for a celebratory breakfast.
cards.short_summary: A historic diner and bakery central to the 'Lou's Challenge' all-nighter tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Students participate in the 'Lou's challenge' by staying up all night to be at Lou's when they open at 6 a.m.
cards.source_title: Places to Eat in Hanover | Dartmouth Admissions
cards.access_notes: Opens at 6:00 AM on weekdays; 7:00 AM on weekends.

cards.title: The On-Campus Bodega
cards.subtitle: Collis Student Center
cards.notes: The go-to spot for late-night snacks, frozen meals, and dorm essentials, conveniently located in the basement of the student center.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus convenience store providing snacks and essentials during evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Collis Market is an on-campus convenience store located in the lower level of the Collis Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by term; typically open late for student convenience.

cards.title: Ramunto's Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: South Street
cards.notes: A staple for New York-style brick oven pizza, popular for group orders and quick slices before the 9:00 PM closing.
cards.short_summary: A local pizzeria known for its brick oven pies and proximity to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramunto's Brick & Brew is located on South Street and serves brick oven pizza.

cards.title: BocaSoca Burritos
cards.subtitle: South Main Street
cards.notes: Formerly Boloco, this spot remains a favorite for burritos and bowls, serving the community until 9:00 PM on most days.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican-inspired grill offering burritos and bowls in the heart of Hanover.
cards.evidence_claim: BocaSoca (formerly Boloco) is located at 35 South Main St and is open until 9 p.m. Monday-Saturday.

cards.title: Sawtooth Late Bites
cards.subtitle: Allen Street
cards.notes: An underground venue offering a full kitchen until 10:00 PM, providing a modern space for late-evening meals and live entertainment.
cards.short_summary: A subterranean restaurant and stage offering evening dining and cultural events.
cards.evidence_claim: Sawtooth Kitchen's kitchen is open nightly until 10:00 p.m.
